title: 10 Minutes of Bio-Shooter
author: indiegatsu
selftext:
Hello! Bio-Shooter is a FPS/TPS set in the human body. Play as the Medicine or the Germ, alone or with friends, and climb the ranks, unlock masteries, titles, create your own emblem and more!

Youtube Link to video: [https://youtu.be/fQrslAlZjHM](https://youtu.be/fQrslAlZjHM) (Too big to post directly to Reddit!) 

Early Access begins November 6th, so be sure to wishlist!

Wishlist: [https://store.steampowered.com/app/5465060/BioShooter/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5465060/BioShooter/)

Would love to hear what you think of the gameplay, what you see is 95% complete for Early Access, with the exception of a few audio replacements and small animation polish.

Early Access will contain 3 Game modes, 3 Maps, and 3 Classes per faction!

The full release is scheduled for early January. Thanks for taking the time to watch the video, and I hope to see you join the fight in the Body!
